request.description: Public registration. Creates an unverified tenant, stores a bcrypt OTP hash in Redis for 10 minutes, sends SMTP email. No tokens or cookies. Supply a real inbox in registrationEmail. 409 for duplicate email, 400 for invalid body/extra role field, 429 after 10 valid requests/IP per 15 minutes, 503 for configured service failures. Verification email includes responsive Homi HTML and plain text, personalized greeting, actual backend OTP expiry and security warning. Use a fresh email or Gmail plus alias for repeat email-design testing.

response.name: 201 - Verification required

request.description: Public email verification. Use the code from Gmail within the registration 600-second expiry. Maximum five attempts. Correct verification marks the user verified and consumes the Redis code without issuing tokens. 400 invalid/expired, 409 already verified, 429 attempt limit, 403 inactive account.

request.description: Resend a verification code for an existing active unverified account. Replaces the prior code, resets attempts, expires in 600 seconds, and enforces a 60-second cooldown plus 10 valid requests/IP/15 minutes. Verified/unknown/inactive accounts receive generic success without mail. 429 cooldown, 400 validation, 503 service failure.

request.description: Public verified-user login. Returns JWT access/refresh tokens; use accessToken as Bearer for protected routes. 401 invalid credentials, 403 unverified/inactive, 400 validation, 429 IP limit, 503 JWT configuration. Login stores a hashed RefreshSession. Refresh rotation rejects reused tokens and revokes the session family.

request.description: Public refresh rotation. Log in again after this feature to obtain a session-backed refresh token. Body token overrides cookie; {} allows cookie fallback. 200 issues replacements and revokes old session. Reusing old token returns 401 and revokes its session family, including the replacement. Concurrent reuse is treated as replay. 403 inactive account; 400 invalid body; 429 IP limit. For the replay test save an old token locally before collection automation overwrites refreshToken.

request.description: Logout the identified refresh family and clear auth cookies. Supply refreshToken in JSON or {} for cookie fallback. No access token required. Repeated/missing/invalid-token logout is idempotent 200; malformed JSON fields return 400. Other login families remain active. Already-issued access JWTs remain valid until expiry. Save the previous refresh token locally before logout if testing revocation; automation clears local token variables on success.
